title: Replace obsolete thread and in-process stream specifications
description:
Translate the three computerless-turn stories into executable feature files before production code changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Use channel and turn terminology; there is no separate thread object.
- Specify turn-scoped SSE and durable replay rather than an in-process subscription.
- Require tenant_id on every bot, channel, message, turn, and job fixture.
- Run Behave and confirm each new scenario fails for the expected missing behavior.
- Remove or rewrite contradictory scenarios instead of supporting both designs.
